challenge: Anthropic x Adaptyv 2026 Challenge 5 / Track 3 (pMHC): de-novo zero-shot binder selective for KRAS G12D VVVGADGVGK on HLA-A*11:01 + b2m
selection_principle: North star: rank by the WEAKEST discrimination margin min(spec_scram, promisc_margin, bp-bh_e), not composite sel; improve the weakest objective; test all three targets (G12D/WT/empty); one convincing pose is not discrimination; submit diverse designs with honest reasoning; computational confidence is a hypothesis, the experiment is the verdict. What shows it recognizes the difference, not merely what the targets share?

features.desc: Orthogonal ensemble MM-GBSA physics gate (OpenMM GBn2) as a CONFIRMATORY FILTER for the buried G12D-vs-WT axis co-fold is blind to — NEVER a ranker
features.evidence: gate_prep/run/score/analyze (scripts/gate/). Calibrated: recovered the Poole ground-truth matched-scaffold ddG=-4.36 [-7.0,-1.6] (exp -4.9, p=0.002) AND nulled a WT-vs-WT control (noise floor ~1.9). Criterion SELECTIVE iff ddG<=-4 AND CI excludes 0. Applied to the 32 decision-set + 26 expansion designs (12-rep deepening on the core) -> runs/campaign/gate/gate_results_{all,unified,merged,deepen2}.tsv. GOTCHA: ante-MMPBSA/sander path is corrupt here (phantom energies) -> use the OpenMM GBn2 path.
features.done_criteria: gate calibrated (recovers ground-truth, nulls a null), self-protecting (unstable pose -> null), used only as a filter; ruler still ranks
features.notes: Consistent with the invariant 'G12D-vs-WT is a bench measurement': the gate is a binary credible/not FILTER on a shortlist, never an in-silico RANK of the axis.

features.desc: Mandatory pose-realism check: a gate-selective call is only credible if the co-fold pose PRESERVES the native buried Asp6<->HLA-Arg114 salt bridge (through-space discrimination), not if it over-docks (swings Asp6 out to grab the binder)
features.evidence: scripts/gate/scan_saltbridge_all.py -> runs/campaign/gate/pose_realism.tsv. 42/58 preserve the bridge (<4A), 15/58 broken (~8A out = over-dock artifact). The naive gate scores broken poses as falsely selective (single-traj MM-GBSA never pays the cost of breaking the buried bridge). Only preserved-pose selectives are credible.
features.done_criteria: every gate-selective call pose-checked; over-docked selectives flagged and denied gate credit (ranked on the ruler)

features.desc: Re-gate the over-docked selectives on a PRESERVED co-fold shard (if one exists) to test whether their selectivity survives on realistic (Asp6-buried) geometry
features.evidence: scripts/gate/find_rescue_poses.py -> rescue_poses.tsv; re-gated nb3_gpu6_432 (5/7 preserved shards) + protein_0103 (1/5), 12-rep -> runs/campaign/gate/gate_results_rescue.tsv. BOTH went NULL on the realistic pose (nb3_gpu6_432 -10.71 -> +7.39, even leans WT; protein_0103 -5.56 -> +1.94) = their selectivity was the over-dock artifact, confirmed. The other 3 over-docked selectives over-dock in 0/7 shards = unrescuable.
features.done_criteria: rescuable over-docked selectives re-gated on preserved poses; rescued iff still selective, else artifact confirmed
features.notes: Result: credible G12D-selective count is DEFINITIVELY 2 (b3_gpu7_113, nb3_gpu4_132).
